verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between the compound (2S,3S)-2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-8-[(2R,3R,4R)-2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-3,5,7-trihydroxy-chroman-4-yl]chromane-3,5,7-triol and the serine/threonine-protein kinase CDC2L2. This compound is identified as a target of another molecule, Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, which in turn is targeted by the compound (1S,2R,3R,4S,5S,6S,8R,9S,10S,13R,16S,17R,18S)-11-ethyl-6,16,18-trimethoxy-13-methyl-11-azahexacyclo[7.7.2.12,5.01,10.03,8.013,17]nonadecane-4,8,9-triol. The final score of 0.5139 indicates a moderate level of confidence in the relationship between the compound and the target kinase. The mechanism involves the compound acting as a substrate or inhibitor of the transporter, which then affects the activity of the kinase. The evidence suggests that the compound may influence the function of CDC2L2 through its interaction with the transporter, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm this relationship.
